name: api-testing-with-bruno
description: The Emoji API, a small CRUD API built for the API Testing with Bruno course at Talking About Testing School.

scripts.test: cd emoji-api-tests && bru run --env local --exclude-tags data-driven --reporter-html ../reports/results.html --reporter-junit ../reports/results.xml
scripts.test:data-driven: cd emoji-api-tests && bru run data-driven/rejected --env local --csv-file-path data/invalid-emojis.csv --reporter-html ../reports/rejected.html && bru run data-driven/accepted --env local --csv-file-path data/valid-emojis.csv --reporter-html ../reports/accepted.html

author: Walmyr Lima e Silva Filho
